title: VEKA | Management & leadership | Board members of VEKA Group
content: Since then, the name and the legal form of the company have changed, but VEKA AG is still 100% owned by the families of Laumann and Hartleif. Elke & Andreas Hartleif win EOY 2025. Our board members, Elke and Andreas Hartleif, have been honoured with the prestigious **EY Entrepreneur Of The Year Award 2025**. Andreas Hartleif, son-in-law of company founder Heinrich Laumann, has been a member of VEKA's Executive Board since 1997. Since 2024, Mr. Hartleif is also the CEO of the Laumann Group, which includes the VEKA Group. As the daughter of the company's founder Heinrich Laumann, Elke Hartleif has been connected with VEKA since her childhood. Since 2024 Mrs. Hartleif ist also Board member and Vice Chairman of the Laumann Group, which includes the VEKA Group as well. Since 2024, Mr. Heitmar has also been the Vice Chairman of VEKA AG and a board member of the Laumann Group, which includes the VEKA Group.
